title: Concept: Struts development mode enabled
description: A Struts devMode flag in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Development mode prints the full stack, the configuration and the value stack for every action, which is the detail an attacker needs to target an individual action.
applicability: Deployments that render a Struts devMode flag into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Development mode prints the full stack, the configuration and the value stack for every action, which is the detail an attacker needs to target an individual action.
